paraphrase: While the human soul is united to the body, the body is the subject that receives the soul's esse, although that esse does not depend on the body. Nothing is said about the separated soul, whose esse belongs to it alone without the body. Not encoded in Lean: an encoding would need the soul and body typed in the EsseReceivedIn vocabulary, a time or state index for 'while united', and a decision whether the body can be the soul's essence or a part of the human essence (DISAMB-ESSE-RECEPTION).
